correctness.rationale: The explicit twenty-vertex graph and deterministic degree-four tie-retaining rule are fully specified. Two independently constructed C++17 enumerators replay the complete set of 1048576 states. One compares consecutive second iterates; the other uses indegree pruning and reverse functional-digraph propagation. Both reproduce 4036 fixed points, 351 primitive two-cycles, entry cutoff seven with witness 64030, all entry populations, the 4387 individual basins and size spectrum. Graph symmetry generators have their adjacency-preservation checked and yield 44 fixed and eight oscillating classes. No finite-to-infinite extrapolation is made.

value.rationale: Folkman is the smallest semisymmetric graph, a natural quartic edge-transitive but non-vertex-transitive benchmark. The first complete majority basin/entrance/symmetry census gives an exact sharp seven-update cutoff, a 26-valued basin spectrum, 44/8 geometric recurrent classes, and the strongly unequal outcome proportions of 959624 fixed-attracted vs 88952 oscillatory-attracted initial states. These natural invariant counts cannot be read from general period-two results, and support direct comparison of quartic semisymmetric and other small regular majority networks; the claim is not an arbitrary graph-label slice.
